newsitem.title: USA: Lehman names co-heads for Los Angeles office.
newsitem.headline: Lehman names co-heads for Los Angeles office.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc on Monday said it named Todd Zelek and Philip Erlanger to jointly run the company's Los Angeles-based investment banking activities.
Lehman said Erlanger and Zelek, both managing directors, would head the firm's corporate finance and advisory business throughout Southern California.

The firm said Zelek would have particular responsibility for general industrial companies as well as companies in a range of growth-oriented industries. Erlanger will focus on expanding Lehman's business with financial services companies.
